preToolUse.bash: f="${PLUGIN_ROOT}/com.github.copilot/hooks/apex-hook.mjs"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then exec node "$f" preToolUse; fi; cat > /dev/null; echo "APEX hook: $f is missing; reinstall the APEX plugin. Call allowed." >&2
preToolUse.powershell: $f = [System.IO.Path]::Combine([string]$env:PLUGIN_ROOT, 'com.github.copilot', 'hooks', 'apex-hook.mjs'); if ([System.IO.File]::Exists($f)) { try { & node $f preToolUse } catch { exit 1 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; [void][Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); [Console]::Error.WriteLine("APEX hook: $f is missing; reinstall the APEX plugin. Call allowed."); exit 0
